title: Multi-screen sprint — context budget discipline
prompt: I need wireframes for the full lakehouse onboarding flow: welcome screen, connect data source, choose schema, preview tables, confirm. Five screens total. Build them in Figma.
success_criteria: All five screens are produced as Figma frames.
Total use_figma calls average <= 4 per screen (per the figma-use batching rule). Hard cap: 24 total.
Each screen explicitly addresses default + at least one alternate state (empty/loading/error).
Design Lead reviews after all five exist (one synthesis pass), not after each individual screen.

deterministic_validators.description: Figma write/capture calls stay within the batching hard cap.
Figma write output includes created node ID evidence.
Transcript references the requested five-screen onboarding flow.

notes: Tests batching discipline at scale and the 'don't review each one individually' efficiency rule.
